claims.text: The hotel is in downtown Tokyo, steps from the Akasaka Prince Classic House and directly connected to the subway station.

findings.quote: Our luxury hotel in downtown Tokyo is superbly located just steps from the iconic Akasaka Prince Classic House, directly connected to the subway station

claims.text: Guests arrive in a soaring Sky Lobby with abundant natural light.

findings.quote: The moment you step into our soaring Sky Lobby, with its abundant natural light

claims.text: Tokyo Garden Terrace Kioicho, where the hotel is situated, has 9 contemporary art pieces installed.

findings.quote: At Tokyo Garden Terrace Kioicho, where this hotel is situated, 9 contemporary art pieces are installed

claims.text: The rooms reflect the design concept 'Levitation'.

findings.quote: The artistic room reflecting the design concept "Levitation" will stage your stay

claims.text: Bathrooms include separate tubs and standup showers.

findings.quote: include separate tubs and standup showers that still get natural daylight thanks to the glass walls

claims.text: A button in the room lets fresh air circulate from outside.

findings.quote: Another button allows fresh air to circulate from outside.

claims.text: The hotel has a spa, an indoor pool and a heated public bath.

findings.quote: Our spa, indoor pool, and heated public bath offer a restorative retreat

claims.text: The gym looks over the city center and is equipped with Technogym equipment from Italy.

findings.quote: overlooking the changing view of the bustling city center. You can work out in the liberating and luxurious space equipped with the latest equipment of Technogym, Italy.

claims.text: Sky Gallery Lounge Levita is a cocktail bar with expansive city views and glass art that resembles a waterfall.

findings.quote: our Tokyo cocktail bar with expansive city views. The bar features glass art that resembles a waterfall

claims.text: WASHOKU SOUTEN serves modern Japanese cuisine, including sushi and teppanyaki, in a crystal-style interior.

findings.quote: serves modern Japanese cuisine, including sushi and teppanyaki. Conveying the freshness of seasonal ingredients, customers sample fantastic flavors in an innovative, crystal-style interior.

claims.text: Wi-Fi is free throughout the entire hotel.

findings.quote: Wi-Fi is free throughout the entire hotel.

claims.text: The indoor swimming pool is on the 30th floor, with poolside deck chairs facing the window so guests can look over the landscape while lying down.

findings.quote: This swimming pool is located on the 30th floor
Deck chairs are installed at the poolside facing the window, and you can look over the landscape even when you are lying down.

claims.text: The hotel displays more than 100 artworks based on the concept of 'Levitation', chosen because it is a high-rise hotel.

findings.quote: features numerous artworks based on the concept of "Levitation," as this is a high-rise hotel. More than 100 pieces of art can be appreciated as if you are in an art gallery.

claims.text: In the Deluxe King, the window is set in an alcove with a daybed built along it, and the bathroom's glass walls can be made clear or opaque at the push of a button.

findings.quote: the window is encased like an alcove with a daybed built along the window
enclosed in glass walls that, just like the sky, can be clear or opaque (depending on which button you push)

claims.text: SPA KIOI by SWISS PERFECTION offers a range of treatments, a lap pool and a couple's suite with dramatic views.

findings.quote: With a range of treatments, a lap pool, and a couple's suite with dramatic views, SPA KIOI by SWISS PERFECTION pampers you.

claims.text: The name Kioicho comes from the initials of the Edo-period Kishu Tokugawa, Owari Tokugawa and Hikone Ii families, whose residences stood here about 400 years ago.

findings.quote: About 400 years ago, during the Edo period, residences of the Kishu Tokugawa family, Owari Tokugawa family, and Hikone Ii family
Thus the name "Kioicho" originated from the initials of these families.

claims.text: The surrounding Nagatacho area is mostly new builds and business towers, though it is prime territory for accessing the rest of the city.

findings.quote: The Nagatacho area is mostly polished off with new builds and business towers, but it’s prime territory for accessing the rest of the city.
